defaults.title: UNBLOCKED — Making Hidden Systems Visible
defaults.description: UNBLOCKED brings creatives and independent thinkers together to investigate the systems shaping our lives, make them visible through creative work, and imagine how they could work differently.

image.alt: UNBLOCKED in large black letters on blue, with pink labels: Dialogue & Creative Expression, Exploring (Hidden) Systems

/posters.title: Ownership Poster Contest — UNBLOCKED
/posters.description: An open call for original poster work exploring ownership, value, money, labour, access and power. Interpret the theme through your own creative perspective.

/guidelines.title: Poster Submission Guidelines — UNBLOCKED
/guidelines.description: How to prepare and submit original poster work for the UNBLOCKED Ownership open call, including eligibility, file requirements and the submission process.

/grants.title: Creative Grants & Residencies — UNBLOCKED
/grants.description: We support artists, designers, technologists, researchers and independent thinkers exploring the systems shaping culture, technology and everyday life.

/grants/culture-grants.title: Culture Grants for Independent Creatives — UNBLOCKED
/grants/culture-grants.description: One-time grants of $500–$5,000 for independent, experimental cultural work responding to UNBLOCKED's themes. Selected projects contribute to a growing public archive.

/grants/open-systems.title: Open Systems Project Support — UNBLOCKED
/grants/open-systems.description: Practical design and experience projects exploring Bitcoin as open money and open intelligence. UNBLOCKED helps develop proposals for Spiral funding.

/submit.title: Submit Your Poster — UNBLOCKED
/submit.description: Submit original poster work responding to the UNBLOCKED Ownership theme. Review the contest process and submission guidelines before entering.

/submit/form/consent.title: Submit Your Poster — UNBLOCKED
/submit/form/consent.description: Complete your UNBLOCKED Ownership poster submission.
